sources.citation: De Boeck, L.B. 1951. La tonologie des parlers bantous du Nord-Ouest du Congo belge. Bulletin des Seances IRCB 22(4): 900-919. [https://www.kaowarsom.be/documents/BULLETINS_MEDEDELINGEN/1951-4.pdf]
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Tone typology only (riverains of Ubangi/Congo/Ngiri/Mongala have 'type lingala' tonology; word tonology not influenced by neighbouring words). Motembo not named; no accent/stress statement.

sources.citation: Motingea Mangulu. 1990. Esquisse de la langue Motembo. In: Parlers riverains de l'entre Ubangi-Zaire: elements de structure grammaticale (Etudes Aequatoria 8), pp. 201-220. Bamanya: Centre Aequatoria. [https://www.aequatoria.be/publications/assets/Etudes_Aequatoria_8_parlers_riverains.pdf]
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: Nothing. I. Phonologie pp.201-203 covers vowels, consonants, vowel processes, open syllables (5), and 6 Tonologie p.203: 'Existent deux tons de base (bas et haut), avec possibilites d'obtenir des tons doubles (descendant et montant)'; only a slight difference from 'type lingala' tonology (initial L of nominal themes realised short falling before L). No mention of accent/stress anywhere in the sketch.

sources.citation: Motingea Mangulu. 1990. La langue des Kunda. In: Parlers riverains de l'entre Ubangi-Zaire (Etudes Aequatoria 8), pp. 162-180. Bamanya: Centre Aequatoria.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: Nothing. Tonologie p.164: 'Il existe deux tons de base bas et haut. Cette tonologie.. est deplacee par endroits'; nouns generally have H on the noun prefix. Vowel elision called 'la caracteristique fondamentale dans la prosodie de cette langue' (p.163). No accent/stress statement.

sources.note: Nothing. Tonologie p.183: two basic tones; tonology 'deplacee' relative to lingala type only for disyllabic BB themes (> DH); H on prefix and augment. No accent/stress statement.
